nodes.name: Google Drive – Watch RFP Folder
nodes.notes: Watches a dedicated Google Drive folder. When a new PDF is dropped, this fires. Set GOOGLE_DRIVE_RFP_FOLDER_ID in n8n Variables.

nodes.name: Extract PDF Text
nodes.notes: Built-in n8n node. Reads the binary PDF and outputs raw text string. Handles tables, columns, multi-page PDFs.

nodes.name: Sellora – POST /ai/extractions/rfp
nodes.notes:
Calls your backend's RFP endpoint. The backend:
1. Extracts all questions with the LLM
2. Rewrites each as a self-contained question
3. Searches pgvector for matching document chunks
4. Answers each question with citations
5. Returns structured JSON

Timeout set to 120s — RFPs with 50-100 questions can take a while.

nodes.name: Parse & Shape Answers
nodes.notes: Reshapes the Sellora response into flat rows suitable for writing to a spreadsheet.

nodes.name: Convert to Excel File
nodes.notes: Writes the answer rows to an XLSX binary. Output is stored in binary property 'rfp_answers'.

_readme.title: Sellora – RFP Processing Pipeline
_readme.description: Full n8n workflow. Watches a Google Drive folder for new PDFs, extracts text, sends to Sellora's /api/v1/ai/extractions/rfp endpoint, writes answers to Excel, and emails back to the engineer.

n8n_variables_required.GOOGLE_DRIVE_RFP_FOLDER_ID: Google Drive folder ID where clients drop RFP PDFs
n8n_variables_required.GOOGLE_DRIVE_ANSWERS_FOLDER_ID: Google Drive folder ID for completed answer files (archive)
n8n_variables_required.SELLORA_BASE_URL: Your Sellora backend URL e.g. https://api.yourcompany.com
n8n_variables_required.ENGINEER_EMAIL: Recipient email address for completed RFP answers

credentials_required: Sellora API Key – HTTP Header Auth with name 'Authorization' and value 'Bearer sk_sellora_YOUR_KEY' (id: sellora_api_key_cred)
Gmail OAuth2 (id: gmail_cred) — or swap for SMTP
how_to_import: 2. Go to Workflows → New → Import from JSON
4. Set up the 3 credentials listed above
5. Set the 5 n8n Variables in Settings → Variables
